_comment: Brute (Revered) hero. Instant - {t}: Pitch the top card of your deck; if it has 6 or more {p}, the crowd cheers you. Whenever the crowd cheers you, create a Toughness token. The crowd-cheer step and its trigger are now canonical (CROWD_CHEER / ON_CHEER). STILL SIMPLIFIED: the activation pitches nothing and skips the 6-power check, so the cheer is unconditional. Kept over a rival her/ implementation that had more structure but was wrong in every part (phantom {r}1 activation cost; the pitch modelled as a COST rather than the effect; REF_PITCH_IS gating the WHOLE ability on the card's pitch VALUE before it was even pitched, with pitch_power_gte silently unread; and the token on an ON_BECOME trigger that never fires for a cheer). Completing this needs two primitives that still do not exist: pitch-top-of-deck and REF_POWER_GTE. See docs/reaudit_opus_batch1.md.
